# signoz_route_policy (Data Source)

Fetches a route policy from SigNoz using its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    signoz = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/signoz/signoz"
    }
  }
}

provider "signoz" {
  endpoint     = "http://localhost:3301"
  access_token = "<SIGNOZ-API-KEY>"
}

data "signoz_route_policy" "get_route_policy" {
  id = "1"
}

output "route_policy" {
  value = data.signoz_route_policy.get_route_policy
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the route policy.

### Read-Only

- `route_name` (String) Name of the route policy.
- `description` (String) Description of the route policy.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the route policy is enabled.
- `matchers` (Attributes List) List of matchers for the route policy. (see below for nested schema)
- `channel_ids` (List of String) List of notification channel IDs.
- `continue_matching` (Boolean) Whether to continue matching subsequent route policies.
- `group_wait` (String) How long to wait before sending a notification about new alerts.
- `group_interval` (String) How long to wait before sending a notification about new alerts in a group.
- `repeat_interval` (String) How long to wait before re-sending a notification.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the route policy.
- `created_by` (String) Creator of the route policy.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time of the route policy.
- `updated_by` (String) Last updater of the route policy.

### Nested Schema for `matchers`

Read-Only:

- `match_name` (String) Name of the matcher field.
- `match_value` (String) Value to match against.
- `match_type` (String) Type of match to perform.
